lines: The Spring 2027 recognition process is now open on EngageSC
for new clubs and clubs coming back after a lapse.
All student organizations must complete recognition
through the online portal, on an annual basis.
Recognition status runs for one academic year.
If you hope to re-establish your club, submit this form.
For questions, contact Campus Activities at the office.
